about: GENERATED by npm run modules:generate from sdk/machines/octatrack/frame-costs-base.json and each module's evidence/frame-cost.json: never edit by hand. What each measured Octatrack module adds to the longest frame interrupt of a reading, in percent of a frame: `first` for one alone on the Part (its first track or slot there, with what waking it from rest adds), `each` for every further one. The site sends this table with every module set (MWMS v2, sdk/runtime/loader/set_package.h, as use = each and wake = first - each); the base judges every module pick by the longest frame it would play, or a full stock load (mw_stock_reserve) with the Part's modules on top when that is more, against mw_frame_line (status.c). `stock`, the base's own figures in percent of a frame, takes the compiled ones' place: the stock reserve for a bank whose busiest step trigs 0 to 8 tracks (`reserveBySteps`), with a margin for what a pattern cannot show (`reserveMargin`) and a floor (`reserveFloor`), the share one sample track takes, which a machine in its place gives back (`trackStock`), and the line no pick may reach (`line`). A module not listed: a machine is charged its measured meter cost or its price (12 % when it names none) a track, an effect nothing, and either 3 % more when it wakes from rest. Measure with `npm run device:price` on a unit: c(n), the longest frame's rise over 8 s with n = 1 to 4 of the module on empty tracks or slots of a medium pattern (trigs every four steps on six tracks, two of them playing samples, about 80 % with stock alone: on a busy one the guard caps the longest frame and a module reads low, and on a track that plays a sample a machine saves that render and reads low). `each` is the steepest step from the third on, max(c3 - c2, c4 - c3); `first` the least that covers every reading with it, the most of c(n) - (n - 1) * each. With one reading only, `first` and `each` are both c(1). Prefer a reading on the newest base. A negative reading counts 0. Base-owned: a module's own folder never changes for it.

stock.measured: Owner's MKII, base 0.8 twin dce1d30e, 22 Nov 2026, Dev17 bank C, stock alone, longest frame: empty pattern 35.9 %, four tracks (two samples) 75.0 %, six (two samples) 79.4 %, eight sample tracks 98.7 % (delays awake 105.6, with LFOs and p-locks 112.8): 7.2 a sample track. Reserve 88: a medium Part with room to grow by about two sample tracks; at it an empty Part refuses no more than a medium one, and the seventh Tape Echo is refused (85 admits it, 92 refuses Amiga + Tape Echo + Mini Verb). Line 120: no render dropped from 95 to 125 % on stock-heavy Parts; module-heavy Parts dropped from about 114 % (3 to 16 in 15-30 s), none at 100-113 %. Eleven picks per session, these curves: 7 of 11 on empty and on medium, 0 renders dropped. Reserve by the busiest step of the bank (22 Nov 2026, owner): 0, 4, 6 and 8 tracks trigging on one step measured (35.9 empty, 75.0, 79.4, 98.7 with eight samples), the rest between; margin 5 for delays, LFOs and p-locks a pattern cannot show; floor 60 so a project built on an empty pattern keeps room for its trigs.
